```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Purpose: `FeaturePlot`s of candidate sub-cluster marker genes (originally
identified in `05-curated_cell_type_marker_genes.Rmd`, on the pre-final,
full dataset), re-plotted here on the Endocardium + Mesenchyme, all-samples,
cell-cycle-genes-removed object. One 4-panel plot per cluster label.

Note: `Pla2g16` (c0 list) is not present in this object's feature set, so
that panel is 3 genes (Itga4, Eln, Myl2). `Cripl`/`Crip` (c5/c6 lists) were
not present either and are used here as `Crip1`, which is.

Cell type per cluster label (matches the `ms_`/`ed_` prefixes in the
original `05-` script): c0/c1/c7/c8 = Mesenchymal, c5/c6/c12 = Endocardial.
Every gene is a positive marker (elevated in that sub-cluster) unless noted
as a negative marker (depleted) below - each panel title is annotated
accordingly.

# Clean-up environment

```{r}
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE)) # will clear all objects includuing hidden objects
gc() # free up memory and report the memory usage
options(max.print = .Machine$integer.max,
        scipen = 999,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
        dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
set.seed(42) # set seed for reproducibility
```

# Load Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
```

# User defined functions

```{r}
save_if <- function(plot_object, filename, width, height, ...) {
  if (save_plots) {
    ggsave(plot = plot_object,
           filename = filename,
           width = width,
           height = height,
           dpi = 300)
  }
}
save_plots <- TRUE
```

# Set project directories and file paths

```{r}
project_repo_dir <- "/home/melanie-smith/workDir/sophieWiszniak/20251104_sophieWiszniak_ncc_pa"
data_dir <- file.path(project_repo_dir, "outDir", "15-rna_velocity")
new_out_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "subcluster_marker_featureplots")

if (!dir.exists(new_out_dir)) {
  dir.create(new_out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

# Load required object
- Endocardium + Mesenchyme, all 4 samples, cell-cycle genes removed, from
  `15.1-add_EGFP_metadata_subset_endocardium_mesenchyme_no_cc.Rmd`.

```{r}
all_samples_endo_mesen_no_cc <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "all_samples_endo_mesen_no_cc_re_embed.rds"))
stopifnot(inherits(all_samples_endo_mesen_no_cc, "Seurat"))

"umap_endo_mesen" %in% Reductions(all_samples_endo_mesen_no_cc)
table(all_samples_endo_mesen_no_cc$new_celltypes)
```

# Shared plot builder

```{r}
# genes_signed: named character vector, e.g. c(Itga4 = "+", Eln = "-", Myl2 = "+")
# - name is the gene, value is "+" (positive/elevated marker) or "-" (negative/depleted marker)
# - each panel's own title is annotated with its sign, since that's lost if
#   left to FeaturePlot()'s default per-feature titling
make_subcluster_featureplot <- function(object, genes_signed, title) {

  gene_names <- names(genes_signed)

  plots <- FeaturePlot(
    object = object,
    features = gene_names,
    reduction = "umap_endo_mesen",
    order = TRUE,
    combine = FALSE
  )

  plots <- lapply(seq_along(plots), function(i) {
    plots[[i]] +
      ggtitle(paste0(gene_names[i], " (", genes_signed[[gene_names[i]]], ")")) +
      scale_colour_gradientn(
        colours = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")),
        name = "Expression"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
  })

  patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = title,
      caption = "Endocardium + Mesenchyme, all samples, cell-cycle genes removed. (+) = positive marker, (-) = negative marker"
    )
}
```

- c0 Mesenchymal (Pla2g16 dropped - not present in this object's feature set)

```{r}
c0_markers <- make_subcluster_featureplot(
  all_samples_endo_mesen_no_cc,
  c(Itga4 = "+", Eln = "-", Myl2 = "+"),
  "c0 Mesenchymal candidate markers"
)
save_if(c0_markers,
       filename = file.path(new_out_dir, "15-umap.c0_mesenchymal_markers.png"),
       width = 12,
       height = 10)
```
